parsed.g: Get the order ID of the newest pending order in the Magento Admin
P_t: Navigated to the Magento Admin Orders page (Sales > Orders)
Opened the Filters panel on the Orders page
Located the Status filter dropdown with 'Pending' as an available option
R_t: Select 'Pending' from the Status filter dropdown
Click 'Apply Filters' to filter orders by Pending status
Sort results by Purchase Date descending (or navigate to last page if ascending) to identify the newest pending order
Read and report the order ID of the newest pending order
